generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The removal of `throws Exception` from the method signature can lead to unhandled exceptions if any of the operations within the method throw a checked exception. This could cause the test to fail silently or unexpectedly.

review_comment: Is there any expectation for a minimum number of addresses that have been collected? Wondering if there's a sanity check that we are in fact testing some number of addresses.
Yes every node must bind to at least one transport address, otherwise it wouldn't be able to join a cluster.

Is the idea here that prepareHealth broadcasts to all nodes / transport addresses? Are we tricking the TransportClient into thinking that each address is a different node? I see `transportClient.addTransportAddresses` eventually ends up [creating a list of DiscoveryNodes](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/d38e4b028f4a9784bb74de339ac1b877e2dbea6f/server/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/client/transport/TransportClientNodesService.java#L188-L199).
No, the `TransportClient` ultimately chooses just one address to which to send the request.
